title: Additivity of invariant infinitesimal coefficients
statement: For an arbitrary scheme $S$ and group scheme $G/S$ [def-sc-group-scheme], let $v,w$ be points over the dual-number thickening $S[\epsilon]$ [def-sc-dual-numbers] reducing to the identity. For every open $U$ of $G$, define $D_v(U)$ by the $\epsilon$ coefficient of the comorphism of $(g,\epsilon)\mapsto g v(\epsilon)$; the inverse image of $U$ is $U$, so this is an additive endomorphism of $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_G)$. Then $D_{vw}=D_v+D_w$ on every open. No affine, field, smoothness or characteristic hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lie-ring obligation docstrings, invariant-extension and mixed-coefficient steps (blueprint sk-d-tangent).

proof.text: The already constructed right translation reduces to the identity and is over S. Apply Scheme.isPullback_dualNumbersProj to its structure morphism to obtain the unique lift to G[epsilon] with projection the right translation and structure map G.hom[epsilon]. This is liftedRightTranslation, whose two triangle equations are proved from IsPullback.lift_fst and lift_snd.

In Over S write p for G[epsilon] to G and k for G[epsilon] to S[epsilon]. The lifted translation F_v satisfies F_v composed with p = p*(k composed with v) and F_v composed with k = k. Precomposition distributes over multiplication, and associativity gives F_v composed with translation_w = translation_(v*w). This is liftedRightTranslation_comp.

Reduction to the identity proves that translation_v-sharp(a).fst=a on every open. The lift fixes epsilon globally because it commutes with G.hom[epsilon], which sends epsilon to epsilon; naturality gives the same assertion on every open. Its value on inl(a) equals translation_v-sharp(a) by the projection triangle. Expand x=inl(x.fst)+inl(x.snd)*inr(1): applying the ring map and taking snd gives D_v(x.fst)+x.snd. Apply this to translation_w-sharp(a), whose fst is a, and use appLE_comp_appLE and the preceding composition equation. Extensionality in U and a proves D_(v*w)=D_v+D_w. All these calculations are proved private helpers in the item.
